I always like to have a broad view of what I do. For example, when I was a teacher, even though I was
                    in the field of language and literature, I liked to have a general understanding of philosophy,
                    history, psychology, sociology, etc. Similarly, even though I am in the Data field today, I like to have
                    a general view of other IT fields. In particular, I have been studying Web Development as a hobby, and
                    here are some projects.
This was my first project while learning web development. The website was created using only HTML5.
The Khaire Inn was my second project, and in it, I used some notions of CSS3 for the first time.
New challenges with more use of HTML5 and CSS3, with new effects.
A local online newspaper with neighborhood news. This project required intermediate knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3.
Here I learned how to start using Bootstrap 4.
This was my first client in Web Development. I built their institutional website using the knowledge I had acquired about Bootstrap 4.
